headline: Oswal Agro Mills submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Post-AGM voting results now on record
summary: Oswal Agro Mills has filed the official scrutinizer report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. The filing completes the statutory compliance procedure following the shareholder gathering. Indian retail shareholders can review the finalized resolution outcomes on the exchange portals.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate financial impact on shareholders.
